{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Public trust is the foundation of public safety, according to police officers.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Police cannot fulfill their role to keep communities safe without public trust and confidence in law enforcement and in the criminal justice system.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There are places in America today where the bonds of trust between communities and law enforcement are frayed or broken.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden took action to enhance public trust by signing a historic executive order on police reform alongside George Floyd's family.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden launched the National Law Enforcement Accountability Database with information on misconduct by federal law enforcement officers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden sharply restricted chokeholds and no-knock warrants for federal law enforcement.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is publishing data on the use of force.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is preventing certain militarized equipment from being sold or transferred to local police agencies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trump oversaw the largest one-year increase in murders ever recorded.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump encouraged the rioters who attacked the police officers protecting the Capitol on January 6.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump has promised to pardon those convicted of crimes related to the attack on the Capitol.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump proposed cutting funding to state and local law enforcement programs, including the COPS program, for three years in a row.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump has called to defund the Department of Justice and the FBI.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump says he will withhold federal funding from local police departments that do not adopt policies like stop-and-frisk or assist in mass deportations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
